message: docs: reconcile delivered hearing reuse and caption presentation policy

edits: , explicit stable-flight-phase audience reuse and bounded geometric sound-transfer reuse are delivered for current sight/hearing. Complete their dense, cold and long-session qualification rather than implementing a second acoustic cache. The receiver index still enumerates and compares memory-capable listeners when its entity snapshot changes; the geometric cache revalidates listener/source poses and falls back to exact queries outside its finite retained entries. Current permission and hearing levels are not cached ([HR03](../limits/hearing-and-speech.md#hr03--geometry-reuse), [cache evidence](../verification/hearing-cache-review.md)). The September 28 perception-intake work did not change hearing; it does not supersede the separate cache delivery
, using this profiler’s bundled-world rate assumption, not a universal engine clock: values below 1 cannot sustain that fixture
digests at matched admitted elapsed-time boundaries are separate evidence; a one-second diagnostic is not the production clock contract

the delivered 20 Hz maximum publication window does not cap rendering to 20 FPS or leak future NPC routes. Any later pose-only publication policy retains this same separation; it is not a prerequisite for testing the current window

document specifies the delivered finite audible-speech contract and explicitly named future extensions. Numerical defaults are reversible gameplay tuning, owned by the [hearing limits inventory](limits/hearing-and-speech.md). [Architecture](architecture.md#hearing-captions-and-perceived-events), [integration evidence](verification/hearing-main-integration.md) and [the hearing tracker](maintainers/hearing-and-speech.md) distinguish delivered behavior and scoped checks from remaining full-scene, accessibility

The installed acoustic policy interprets `acousticTransmission` as a **broadband energy/intensity transmission ratio**, in [0, 1]. The cutover replaced the earlier binary hearing gate; historical starter coefficients are not evidence of physical calibration. Further coefficient changes are authored-world tuning, not a missing acoustic integration

Volume is already part of the existing talk operation and native speech admission, not another command family. These are its speech fields; the strict model operation also supplies nullable `selfIntroduction` under [the naming contract](entity-names.md), while native callers may omit that optional claim

Current v1 exposes the authored delivery mode for the speaker’s own utterance, or when another listener visually associates the source and detects its speech; otherwise delivery is absent. Clear words alone do not grant hidden-speaker identity or delivery mode. Visual-only detection does not justify “John is whispering.” A later acoustic delivery-recognition rule needs its own supported policy; a model cannot supply another listener’

The current mask is chosen once at commitment by a versioned event/listener-local deterministic stream, keyed from the world seed and occurrence/listener identity without consuming the shared simulation RNG
The delivered lightweight speech captions are separate from work/progress notices on the

and [HR04](limits/hearing-and-speech.md#hr04--caption-density-and-lifetime) for the current numerical reading/queue policy. Reading time uses the greater of word-based and character-based estimates for the displayed chunk, plus orientation time, clamped before the user’s reading-time multiplier. Count only display-permitted content, not hidden original words. Labels without linguistic fragments use their permitted display text; they are not forced to a separate duration formula

The current overlay allows one active utterance/chunk per identified source presentation, with the per-speaker and overlay active/pending bounds in HR04. Unknown sources must not be grouped using hidden speaker ID
Discard a pending caption or an active caption that has remained layout-hidden for the HR04 unpaused residence window

The delivered rich hearing queries distinguish physical exposure, detection and intelligible speech. Preserve that distinction in callers: do not redefine a full-speech eligibility check to mean merely “detected something” while callers still assume full quotes and identit

Selecting an awareness-qualified event and then rendering `event.text` or `event.data.text` remains a regression hazard, not the intended rich-speech projection. Consumers must project the listener’s stored evidence in the hot view, paginated history, Talk, World Events, narration, cognition, embedding, summaries, social appraisal and promise/commitment handling. The delivered HE02–HE04 integrations are not a requirement to rebuild these paths; remaining coverage belongs to HE05

The current [HR03](limits/hearing-and-speech.md#hr03--geometry-reuse) receiver-volume index and finite geometric transfer cache already reuse immutable inputs. They do not cache permission, intelligibility or identity. Further retention/churn optimizations require measured need; a cache miss or retention bound takes the exact path rather than shrinking the audience
